failures.test: gateway revokes an in-flight behavior command when the worker HTTP client disconnects
failures.rootCause: client disconnect aborted the behavior executor, and its generic abort receipt could settle before the supervisor projected the client-disconnect revocation cause
failures.correction: make client disconnect a sticky supervisor cause, check it before interpreting settled behavior receipts, and suppress behavior start when the external signal is already aborted

staticHardeningFindings.finding: in-flight behavior command survived fence loss because gateway used synchronous Docker execution
staticHardeningFindings.correction: async fence-bound named-container execution with PostgreSQL re-verification, AbortSignal revocation and repeated docker rm -f cleanup

staticHardeningFindings.finding: model-controlled tasks without behaviorGate could still run as root and inspect/reach worker control-plane authority
staticHardeningFindings.correction: all executionMode=agent tasks require copy workspace, run as UID/GID 10001 in isolated process group, remove control-plane env and inherit UID-scoped private-network egress guard

staticHardeningFindings.finding: restricted model UID did not own the external Runtime task output directory used for handoff creation
staticHardeningFindings.correction: move handoff/repair artifacts into dedicated agent-output-attempt-N subdirectory owned by UID/GID 10001 while Task Brief/context/descriptor/log/result remain parent control-plane authority

staticHardeningFindings.finding: PostgreSQL capability verifier could wait on dependency failure longer than the authority supervision loop
staticHardeningFindings.correction: bounded PostgreSQL connect/query/statement timeouts plus gateway-side bounded capability checks
